info.title: v2.shop_category.get_item_list
info.description: Use this call to get items list of certain shop_category

get.description: Use this call to get items list of certain shop_category

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: page_no
parameters.description: If many items are available to retrieve, you may need to call this api multiple times to retrieve all the data. And the default will be 0. page_size*page_no should be [0, 2147483446].

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Specifies the starting entry of data to return in the current call. Default is 1000. The input range of page_size is [0, 1000]
